Read a fixed dashboard dataset with coverage and provenance

Source: R/data.R
btg_get_data.Rd

Reads one dataset from the bundled catalogue, verifies its checksum, applies the requested selection and returns the rows with their monthly coverage and provenance. Rates divide recorded events by Census 2021 residents. They are not individual stop probabilities or causal estimates.

Usage

btg_get_data(
  dataset = "force_disparity",
  force = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  council = NULL,
  release = NULL
)

Arguments

dataset

A dataset name from btg_datasets(). The default, "force_disparity", is the original 2025 Black to White force comparison.

force

Optional character vector of exact Police.uk identifiers, such as "metropolitan", for force-level datasets. See x$data$force.

years

Calendar years to keep. NULL keeps every year the dataset holds; force_disparity holds 2025 only.

groups

Ethnic groups to keep, for datasets with a group column. NULL keeps all of them.

council

Optional character vector of ONS local-authority codes, such as "E09000022", for the council-level dataset. See x$data$council.

release

A value from btg_releases(). NULL selects the dataset's default release; saved views always carry an explicit release identifier.

Value

A btg_dataset list containing an ordinary data frame data, a coverage data frame of force-month submission statuses (NULL for datasets without one), an explicit metadata list and a selection list. Missing force returns remain missing; they are never imputed as zero stops.

Details

Force-level comparison datasets hold group and White counts, known and unknown ethnicity counts, Census populations, rates per 1,000, the rate ratio, approximate Poisson log-ratio intervals, display eligibility, ranks within each year and group, and submission coverage. The intervals condition on recorded counts and fixed denominators: they do not capture missing-return, classification or exposure uncertainty. eligible reproduces the dashboard's rule (positive finite ratio and at least 200 records with known ethnicity, with resident-rate exclusions). It does not imply complete reporting. The dashboard verifies monthly submissions only inside a recent window; earlier months are unverified, never assumed supplied. See system.file("NOTES", "data-dictionary.md", package = "BlackThriveSS") for every column.

Examples

x <- btg_get_data()
head(x$data)
